forged_limbs.code:
def run(intent, city_query, geo_json, geo_status, search_results, question):
    lat = None
    lon = None
    name = city_query or ''
    country = ''
    admin1 = ''
    ok = False
    if intent in ('city_outlook', 'rain_check') and isinstance(geo_json, dict):
        results = geo_json.get('results') or []
        if results:
            top = results[0] or {}
            lat = top.get('latitude')
            lon = top.get('longitude')
            name = top.get('name') or name
            country = top.get('country') or ''
            admin1 = top.get('admin1') or ''
            ok = lat is not None and lon is not None
    return {'ok': ok, 'latitude': lat, 'longitude': lon, 'city_name': name, 'country': country, 'admin1': admin1, 'search_hits': len(search_results or [])}
